question: Who is the first Indian to claim World No. 1 ranking in the U-19 Girls Singles category in the Badminton World Federation junior rankings?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tasnim Mir.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
